_help.what_is_this: Single-source unit configuration. Edit ONLY this file when cloning/branching for a new unit.
_help.how_annotations_work: This file is valid JSON. Anything under keys starting with '_' is ignored by the app (used as documentation).
quick_start_checklist: 4) sheets.*CsvUrl (3 published CSV links from Google Sheets)

_example_values.asset_paths: Put images/videos in /public then reference them like '/logo.png' or '/video/background.webm'

unit._help: Shown in header + page titles + various UI areas.
unit.name: UNIT NAME HERE

_help_defaultTitle: Document title prefix. Example result: 'UNIT ORBAT | Roster' (depends on route/view).
_help_icon: Browser tab favicon + some UI/logo spots. Place file in /public/brand/ then reference with leading '/'.
_help_initialSlug: Default selection when opening roster (commonly the root element slug). Keep as a string.
_help_planetPath: Background video (or image) used on the landing/login/boot screen (depending on your build). Put in /public/backgrounds/.

header._help: Top header/banner fields. Change these to match your unit theme/lore.

branding._help: Optional header-specific branding. Assets should be placed under /public and referenced from site root.

sheets._help: Publish each sheet tab to CSV and paste URLs here. These must be publicly accessible CSV endpoints.

deployment._help_execUrl: Netlify Function endpoint used to proxy Google Apps Script (admin/write actions).
deployment._help_rankIcons: Rank icons are resolved like `${rankIconBase}/${rankCode}.${rankIconExt}`. Put icons in /public/ranks/.

ui._help: Optional UI text overrides. If your build doesn’t use some of these, they’ll be safely ignored.

login._help: Login overlay text (if enabled in your build).
login.title: SECURE ACCESS TERMINAL
login.subtitle: ENTER CREDENTIALS

boot._help: Boot/handshake screen copy (if enabled in your build).
boot.title: INITIALIZING ORBAT INTERFACE

terminal._help: Terminal ‘flavor text’ pool used for scrolling/random feed lines. Keep it generic so any unit can reuse.
feedPool: NOTICE: OPERATIONAL DATA SUBJECT TO CHANGE

pilotSpecialInfo._help: Optional mapping for custom per-person badges/notes keyed by member ID/slug (only if your build supports it).
